name: WinMon
detailed_description:
WinMonis a cozy-yet-chaotic idle hunting and life-sim hybrid where you raise, evolve, and command adorable tiny monster creatures known as WinMon. Whether you're grinding through study sessions or enduring long workdays, your WinMon are always by your side on your desktop screen—cute, fierce, and just a little bit hungry for battle. Welcome to their tiny playground, where life is as much about shooting preys as it is about fruit snacks and friendship.

Features

Idle Combat Meets Life Sim
WinMon will stroll around, hunt, and harvest their AI preys even when you're away—but they need your help to thrive. Keep them fed, manage their behavior, and ensure they don’t get too cranky when hungry!

Hunger & Happiness System
WinMon  get hungry over time. Let them forage for fruits from AI preys to keep them active, healthy, and productive. A well-fed WinMon is a happy (and profitable) WinMon.

Evolution Through Battle
Watch your WinMon grow! By hunting AI preys and gaining experience, WinMon can evolve into stronger forms with new appearances. Merge two max-level WinMons of the same kind to unlock their evolved version.

Customizable Playground
Decorate and upgrade your WinMons’ playground with facilities and items. From clinics that slow hunger loss to fruit droppers and coin collectors, every addition changes how your tiny playground works.

Built for Desktop Companionship
Tiny Gunmon runs quietly in the background, making it a perfect companion while you work or study. Check in on your Gunmons, collect some coins, and get back to your tasks—with a smile.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Dual Core 2 GHz
  • Graphics: Graphic Card with VRAM 2 GB or higher
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
